details.services_summary: Design, develop, test, deploy and support a revenue management and guest analytics platform for nine hotels in Saudi Arabia.

delay_penalty.quote: Should the Service Provider fail to achieve any Milestone by its scheduled completion date, the Service Provider shall pay to the Company, by way of liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to one percent (1%) of the Contract Value for each week or part thereof of delay.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Guest Data must be hosted within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

findings.title: Al Noor Hospitality Group: Data analytics, AI or revenue-management services
findings.why: Al Noor Hospitality Group non-compete covers data analytics or revenue-management services for any hospitality business in Saudi Arabia until 2029-09-14.
findings.comparison: Do not take analytics, AI or revenue-management work for hotel groups in the GCC until about September 2029 without Al Noor's written consent.
findings.quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
findings.exception: Clause 12.4 lets Al Noor waive it per engagement by written consent. Waiver letter of 10 Feb 2026 allows only the Seaside Hotels (Muscat) demand-forecasting SOW; not follow-on SOWs, other hotels or Affiliates.

findings.title: Delay penalties calculated on total contract value
findings.why: 1% of total contract value per week can rapidly consume margins and exceed milestone earnings.
findings.comparison: Al Noor caps at 10% of total fees, but Acme and others tie penalties to the specific milestone fee.
findings.quote: an amount equal to one percent (1%) of the Contract Value for each week or part thereof of delay.

findings.title: Delay penalty exclusions omit client-caused delays
findings.why: Fails to exclude client-caused delays and scope changes, risking penalties for delays outside AtliQ's control.
findings.comparison: Principles and past contracts (Acme, Northwind) explicitly exclude client-caused delays from penalties.
findings.quote: The Service Provider shall not be liable for delay to the extent such delay is caused by a Force Majeure Event as defined in Clause 15.

findings.title: Arabic text prevails in inconsistency
findings.why: AtliQ operates in English; if an Arabic translation differs, AtliQ may be bound by terms it cannot verify.
findings.comparison: Not standard in AtliQ's past contracts which are typically English-only.
findings.quote: In the event of any inconsistency, the Arabic text shall prevail.

findings.title: Indian entity under non-Indian law (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia)
findings.why: Disputes would be fought under foreign law and courts.
findings.comparison: Principle: India for AtliQ Pvt Ltd. Past exceptions (Al Noor DIFC, Northwind English law) were deliberate.
findings.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws and regulations in force in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

findings.title: Payment in 60 days
findings.why: Long payment terms hurt cash flow.
findings.quote: The Company shall pay each undisputed invoice within sixty (60) days from the date of receipt of a valid invoice.

findings.title: Liability cap exceptions include confidentiality and data protection
findings.why: Uncaps liability for breaches of confidentiality and data protection, exposing AtliQ to disproportionate risks beyond contract value.
findings.comparison: AtliQ prefers a standard 1x cap without broad carve-outs for data or confidentiality.
findings.quote: Save in respect of liability arising from fraud, wilful misconduct, breach of Clause 7 (Confidentiality) or Clause 13 (Data Protection), each Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the Contract Value.

findings.title: Data localization restriction to Saudi Arabia
findings.why: Restricts data hosting to KSA, which may conflict with AtliQ's standard cloud infrastructure and tools.
findings.comparison: Not present in most standard contracts unless regional compliance dictates it.
findings.quote: Guest Data shall be hosted within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia unless the Company provides prior written approval

findings.title: No subcontracting without prior written consent
findings.why: Restricts AtliQ from using subcontractors or cloud providers without client consent.
findings.comparison: AtliQ normally retains standard subcontracting flexibility.
findings.quote: The Service Provider shall not assign or subcontract any of its obligations without the prior written consent of the Company.
